investment_thesis.summary: IREN operates an institutional-scale renewable energy and high-voltage electrical substation footprint (2.8 GW), executing a dual-monetization model across low-cost Bitcoin mining and high-performance AI data center colocation.
return_engines: Engine 1: 35 EH/s proprietary Bitcoin mining fleet delivering sub-$0.038/kWh power costs
Engine 2: High-density data center campus development contracting hyperscaler GPU colocation
Engine 3: Flexible load curtailment revenue and energy market arbitrage
market_implied_assumptions: Valuation prices company primarily as a cyclical commodity miner subject to halving compression
Discounts the replacement cost value of multi-gigawatt energized utility interconnections
why_price_may_differ_from_value: The market has not fully re-rated IREN from a pure-play crypto miner into an essential digital infrastructure landlord with multi-year take-or-pay compute contracts.

conditions: AI HPC colocation contracts scale to over 500 MW; gross margins exceed 65%
Mining efficiency remains industry-leading; spot BTC averages >$90,000
failure_conditions: Failure to convert power pipeline into signed enterprise compute contracts

conditions: Mining fleet operates at 35-40 EH/s; progressive colocation conversion of 150-250 MW
HPC infrastructure buildout suffers major execution delays and cost overruns
Hash price drops below $35/PH/day compressing mining gross profit
failure_conditions: Major substation permitting revocation or grid transmission disconnect

valuation.explanation: Sum-of-the-parts valuation balancing depreciated ASIC mining replacement value against enterprise data center infrastructure capitalization rates.

catalysts.name: Commercial Commissioning of Texas Substation Phase 2
catalysts.expected_effect: Confirm energization of next-generation GPU colocation capacity

risks: Execution delays in electrical transformer and liquid-cooling hardware supply chains
Power utility rate revisions increasing baseload industrial tariffs
Dilution from infrastructure growth equity offerings
invalidation_conditions: Sustained failure to secure commercial tenants for HPC colocation capacity
Total delivered cost per Bitcoin mined exceeding spot market price

decision.summary: IREN is fairly priced to modestly undervalued at $44.45, offering a low-cost power moat that bridges Bitcoin hash rates with enterprise high-performance computing.
required_actions: Accumulate within the fair value range ($42.10-$45.00)
Add aggressively if market volatility drives price into the attractive zone (<$39.80)

sources.name: IREN Ltd SEC Filings & Monthly Operational Updates
